# New editor labels (for the Dashboard)

Keys the app schema adds that the web schema does not have, with their English text. The Dashboard translates them from its catalog (`i18n/translations.json`, 12 locales): they are in ordering-dashboard's `main` (the `BUILDER_THEME_PROP_*` labels with 4ae08cc26), and `BUILDER_THEME_PROP_CONTEXT_TEXT` in the Dashboard's pull request #524 (the app now labels that text `BUILDER_THEME_PROP_ORDER_OPTIONS_TEXT`). A key added to the schema later goes there too.

## Keys the app takes from the web schema

The order type images, the Icons group of images and three visibility items carry the web schema's own label keys. The Dashboard's catalog already has them: nothing to add.

|---|---|
| `BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_ICONS` | Icons |
| `BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_ORDER_TYPES` | Order types |

| `BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_ORDER_TYPES_DRIVE_THRU` | Drive-thru |
| `BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_ORDER_TYPES_EAT_IN` | Eat in |
| `BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_ORDER_TYPES_PICKUP` | Pickup |
| `BUILDER_THEME_IMAGES_ORDER_TYPES_RESERVATION` | Reservation |
| `BUILDER_THEME_VIS_ITEM_BUSINESS_HEADER_DISTANCE` | Distance |
| `BUILDER_THEME_VIS_ITEM_CHECKOUT_BUSINESS_ADDRESS` | Store address |
